transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Just avoid heavy work or lifting for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thank you. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you were told otherwise. If you’re running low, your GP can provide more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: Mild sensitivity to light can be normal as the eye adjusts, and wearing sunglasses outside can help. But significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity, especially if the eye is red and painful, is not normal and may need checking. Do you have any other questions?
